notes.title: GLO Releasing on PS4, PS5 & Nintendo Switch
notes.content:
GLO is finally coming to the PS4, PS5 and Nintendo Switch on September 9th 2021!
Find out all about it on the Chronik Spartan Blog:
https://www.chronikspartan.com/getting-my-indie-game-released-on-playstation-5-nintendo-switch/

Cheers!
Chronik Spartan

notes.title: Exclusive Access to Chronik Spartan Games Beta Testing
notes.content:
The new and updated Chronik Spartan discord server has just launched!

https://discord.gg/XPU6x5R

Some might ask “What is a discord server?” It’s a place to chat and share ideas about similar interests. In this case current and future Chronik Spartan Games and all things game related.

All members gain exclusive access to beta testing for all future games.

When you join the first thing you’ll want to do is pick your allegiance! Are you #WolfSpartan, #RavenSpartan or #PsychoSpartan?

You will then be able to compete in challenges to earn awesome rewards for your team! As well as ARGs, in depth coverage of game development, sharing of game features and loads of other cool stuff!

It’s going to be a fun and exciting place to be and I’d love to see my closest followers (you obviously!) over there!

Don’t forget to pick a team and get stuck in.

https://discord.gg/XPU6x5R

notes.title: Discussions
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

A big apology to anyone who has posted on the discussions page only to not get a response from me yet!

I had assumed I would get a notification for any messages posted so I had not been directly checking the forums. Now I realise I don't get a notification I'll be actively checking to discussions and responding. I've responded to all existing posts, but sorry it took so long!

Thanks again!

notes.content:

For those that completed the game you can replay the final boss and it will unlock all the game completion achievements you should have already unlocked.

Thanks for being patient!

notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.content:
Theres been a quick update to the achievements to remove two that ended up being impossible to attain. No one likes impossible achievements! 

They became impossible following updates to make some of the later levels more exciting. I believe a better game experience is more important than two extra achievements.

notes.title: Game Updates
notes.content:
After a fantastic amount of feedback from play testing at the PLAY Expo I've put in a few updates to make GLO an even better experience. The updates include:

1. Better tutorial page detailing the different bullet types and pickups in GLO.
2. Tweaks to the levels to provide a smoother progression to the difficulty curve.
3. An update to aiming where your previous aiming position is remembered to make shooting while jumping more comfortable. 

Thanks!

notes.title: Trading Cards
notes.content:
To confirm I will be adding Trading Cards to GLO. I have them all created and ready to go.

Unfortunately the Trading Cards won't be available from day one due to the latest policy enforced by Valve to try and stop bad actors from exploiting the store algorithm for financial gain.

As soon as GLO reaches the confidence metric, the cards will drop to all users, including all the users who've played GLO prior to that point.

notes.title: Glo Content Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I can officially confirm that Glo will be shipping with 100 levels and four boss encounters across four worlds.

With regards to the development progress, all 100 levels and the bosses are now complete. Over the next week the levels and boss encounters will be refined followed up with some nice polish.

I can't wait to get Glo out to you all and progress is coming across very nicely.

Thanks!

notes.title: Welcome Everybody
notes.content:
Hello to everyone and a big thank you to all you Wishlisters.
I'm Stavros Pilatis, one whole of UK independent studio Chronik Spartan.
I'll be posting regular updates on the progress of Glo up to and beyond release date  (23rd October). Any particular questions/thoughts/comments please don't hesitate to ask!
Thank you again and welcome!
